trustRoots.owner: Wand Rust CORE through private Worker
trustRoots.source: immutable encrypted original P1G bytes selected locally, verified original SHA256
trustRoots.build: explicit externally evidenced BID; schema cannot infer BID
trustRoots.session: Worker-created opaque session identity and generation, never accepted from Svelte
trustRoots.revision: Core atomic monotonic revision; Undo/Redo invalidate index/cursors
trustRoots.indexGeneration: Core increments on affected domain index rederive; never UI-supplied
trustRoots.cursor: Core-minted private random handle or authenticated token, single-use, bounded, expiry
trustRoots.completion: derived exclusively from complete source-index enumeration, not truncated watch list
trustRoots.references: Core source-derived graph with typed missing-reference Fail Closed, no UI-supplied graph
trustRoots.authority: READ-only capability issued only by accepted CORE; never from a response field alone

messageProtocol.open: CORE->Worker: authenticated read identity; Worker->UI: bounded detached identity; stale old File sessions closed
messageProtocol.query: UI->Worker: domain/view/filter/sort/limit/cursor; accepted cursor must match exact bound scope and consume once
messageProtocol.page: CORE privately proves read authority, valid cursor and accurate complete/total; Worker enforces producer size limits before postMessage; UI independently fences
messageProtocol.cancel: AbortSignal/close/new File/revision/index update/Worker failure invalidates tickets and drops delayed pages
messageProtocol.boundedResponseSequence: Core verifies source/index/session/revision+cursor expiry and consumes cursor once; WEB bridge checks scope/sequence; Producer UTF8 limits before postMessage

transport.tooLarge: error, not truncation or silent completion
transport.knownRemainingRisk: bounded output != bounded memory during full Core indexing or P1G decode
